decls.description: The journal state for a single effect plan, shared across runs with contracts/effect.yaml.

applied.description: Matching effect evidence has been confirmed.

applying.description: The sole attempt is durably claimed before sending the request.

cleaned.description: Cleanup was confirmed. The original attempt remains consumed.

failed.description: The consumed attempt was definitively rejected. An uncertain response is not failure.

planned.description: The exact plan is retained and the attempt is available to claim.

unknown.description: The attempt is consumed and its outcome is uncertain. Reconcile only.

decls.description: The recorded outcome of one journaled effect attempt.

claimed.description: The claim was made and no answer was recorded.

refused.description: The attempt was definitively refused before applying.

sent.description: The request was sent and accepted.

unknown.description: The outcome of the sent attempt is uncertain.

decls.description: What a complete target readback observed after an effect attempt.

before.description: The target still shows the state before the effect.

expected.description: The target shows what the plan produces.

other.description: The target shows another state that neither matches the plan nor the prior state.

decls.description: The exact planned input of one effect. Its id is the idempotency key (the plan hash).
One journaled attempt for a planned effect, as the effect adapter recorded it.
A complete read of an effect target after an attempt, settling only with a receipt of its own run and tick.

lines: // Shared effect lifecycle and once-per-plan settling rules (decisions/loop-engine-epoch.md, section 5).
// Permission for a planned effect is supplied by the importing pack; a declaration alone denotes the empty set.
.decl effect_permitted(run: symbol, step: symbol, plan: symbol, reason: symbol)
.decl effect_attempt(run: symbol, plan: symbol, sent_at: number, outcome: symbol)
.decl effect_latest_attempt(run: symbol, plan: symbol, sent_at: number)
.decl effect_effective_attempt(run: symbol, plan: symbol, sent_at: number)
.decl effect_planned(run: symbol, step: symbol, plan: symbol, reason: symbol)
.decl effect_readback(run: symbol, plan: symbol, tick: number, state: symbol)
.decl effect_readback_expected(run: symbol, plan: symbol, tick: number)
.decl effect_readback_before(run: symbol, plan: symbol, tick: number)
.decl effect_readback_other(run: symbol, plan: symbol, tick: number)
.decl effect_settling_readback(run: symbol, plan: symbol, sent_at: number, tick: number, outcome: symbol)
.decl effect_settled_earlier(run: symbol, plan: symbol, sent_at: number, tick: number)
.decl effect_first_settling(run: symbol, plan: symbol, sent_at: number, outcome: symbol)
.decl effect_discarded(run: symbol, plan: symbol, reason: symbol)
.decl effect_confirmed(run: symbol, plan: symbol, reason: symbol)
.decl effect_pending(run: symbol, plan: symbol, reason: symbol)
.decl effect_state(run: symbol, plan: symbol, state: symbol, reason: symbol)
// Any journaled attempt of a plan in a run with a source consumes its key, whatever its outcome.
// Only readbacks strictly after the latest recorded attempt of a plan can settle it.
latest = max sent_at : { effect_attempt(run, plan, sent_at, _) }.
// A claimed, sent or unknown attempt may have changed the target, so only a later receipted readback settles it.
effect_effective_attempt(run, plan, sent_at) :- effect_attempt(run, plan, sent_at, "claimed").
effect_effective_attempt(run, plan, sent_at) :- effect_attempt(run, plan, sent_at, "sent").
effect_effective_attempt(run, plan, sent_at) :- effect_attempt(run, plan, sent_at, "unknown").
// Only an unblocked step's permitted plan without an attempt may go out through the effect port.
// A target readback counts only with a source and a sweep receipt of its own run at its own tick.
effect_readback_expected(run, plan, tick) :- effect_readback(run, plan, tick, "expected").
effect_readback_before(run, plan, tick) :- effect_readback(run, plan, tick, "before").
effect_readback_other(run, plan, tick) :- effect_readback(run, plan, tick, "other").
// A settling readback is a receipted readback of the same run strictly after the latest attempt
// with an unambiguous expected or other state.
// The first settling readback after the latest attempt decides.
// Discard when the first settling readback after the latest attempt shows another state,
// or when only a refused attempt exists.
// Confirm when the first settling readback after the latest attempt shows the expected state
// An effective attempt without a settling readback remains pending until reconciled.
// A claimed attempt stays in applying until a submission outcome or settling readback is recorded.
// Derived journal states matching contracts/effect.yaml EffectState (cleaned is supplied by a later cleanup plan).

module.description: Planned effects, journaled attempts, target readbacks and effect journal states (decisions/loop-engine-epoch.md).
